title: feat(cloud-connection): mount the declared-rename planner without the install door
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9TnmocPa6rwDNpdaUh984EN)_
Fixes #31895

Clause-②: yes (widening) — one new root export of `@objectstack/cloud-connection`, `MarketplaceInstallRenamePlannerPlugin`. The planner signature, its result types and the service name are unchanged, and nothing is narrowed.
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：`@objectstack/cloud-connection` 新增 `MarketplaceInstallRenamePlannerPlugin`,只注册「声明式重命名规划器」这一个服务(`marketplace-install-rename-planner`),不挂安装路由、不读写安装账本;规划器实现搬进独立模块，安装入口插件和新插件都从那里注册同一份。
- 为什么改：之前只有安装入口插件注册这个服务，托管环境的内核不挂安装入口，拿不到规划器,cloud#3862 因此卡住。
- 风险与回滚：只挂安装入口的宿主行为不变(服务照旧在，现有声明式重命名测试一条未改全绿);两者同挂时先初始化的那个注册，后者看到已存在就跳过，不会触发内核的重复注册报错。回滚 = revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`packages/cloud-connection/src/marketplace-install-rename-planner.ts`(`registerInstallRenamePlanner` 的存在检查);`marketplace-install-local-plugin.ts` 的 `init` 一段;测试文件末尾新的 describe。
- 两分钟验证:`cd packages/cloud-connection && pnpm exec vitest run src/marketplace-install-local-declared-rename.test.ts`,预期 27 passed。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- **New module `marketplace-install-rename-planner.ts`**, the planner's one implementation: `planDeclaredRenames` (moved out of the door plugin, body unchanged), `convertPackageBodyForward` and `packageUpgradeSideOf` (moved, bodies unchanged), `createInstallRenamePlanner(ctx)` (the service object the door built inline), and `registerInstallRenamePlanner(ctx)`, which registers the service unless the kernel already holds it (`ctx.getServices().has(…)`).
- **New plugin `MarketplaceInstallRenamePlannerPlugin`** (`com.objectstack.runtime.marketplace-install-rename-planner`), exported from the package root. `init()` calls `registerInstallRenamePlanner`; `providesServices` declares only `marketplace-install-rename-planner`. No `start()`, no route, no ledger, no rehydrate. The planner resolves `objectql` (engine and driver) when `plan()` is called, never at init.
- **`MarketplaceInstallLocalPlugin`**: `init()` registers the planner through the same `registerInstallRenamePlanner`; step 2c″ calls the shared `planDeclaredRenames`; its private `convertPackageBodyForward` delegates to the shared one. `providesServices` still declares both services. Unused imports dropped.
- Planner signature, `InstallRenamePlan*` types and the service name are unchanged.

Mount for a kernel with no install door (cloud#3862's pin round):

```ts
await kernel.use(new ObjectQLPlugin());
await kernel.use(new MarketplaceInstallRenamePlannerPlugin());
```

## Why

The planner exported by #31801 was registered only inside the install door's `init()`. A hosted environment kernel does not mount the door, so `getService('marketplace-install-rename-planner')` threw there, and mounting the door just to get the planner would hand the tenant the install, uninstall, reseed and purge routes.

Step 0 (origin/main `6a8f4151`, real `ObjectKernel`):

| Reading | Result |
|:--|:--|
| `ObjectQLPlugin` only, `getService(planner)` | throws `[Kernel] Service 'marketplace-install-rename-planner' not found` |
| CONTROL: plus `MarketplaceInstallLocalPlugin` | present, `plan` is a function |
| Same service name registered by two plugins' `init()` | `bootstrap()` rejects `[Kernel] Service 'X' already registered`, kernel state `stopped` |
| A door-less mount already on main | none (`git grep` of the service name and constant: only cloud-connection's door) |

The third row is why both mounts go through `registerInstallRenamePlanner`'s presence check.

## Tests

One new top-level describe in the shared harness `marketplace-install-local-declared-rename.test.ts` (6 cases); no existing test edited.

- Real `ObjectKernel` + `ObjectQLPlugin` + the new plugin: the service resolves and `plan()` answers the same plan as a door kernel for the same versions.
- Same planner over a carrying driver (the harness's `fakeDriver`), in a context with no door: the carry equals the door planner's and the door's `renamesCarried`.
- Door-less kernel with an http-server route probe: no route mounted, no `marketplace-install-local` service, no ledger file.
- CONTROL: door-only kernel keeps the planner, and the probe sees the door's `POST /api/v1/marketplace/install-local`.
- Both mounted, each order: kernel `running`, one service, the plan answers.

Ablations (each through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, restored blob == HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty):

<details><summary>A: new plugin registers nothing → 3 red</summary>

```
× a kernel with no install door resolves the planner, and its plan is the door's for the same versions
× over a driver that carries, the door-less planner names the carry the door then performs
× the door-less kernel mounts no install-local route and holds none of the door's other services
Error: [Kernel] Service 'marketplace-install-rename-planner' not found
Tests  3 failed | 24 passed (27)
```
</details>

<details><summary>B: presence check removed → both-order pins red</summary>

```
× both mounted (planner plugin first) ...
× both mounted (install door first) ...
Error: [Kernel] Service 'marketplace-install-rename-planner' already registered
Tests  2 failed | 25 passed (27)
```
</details>

<details><summary>C: new plugin also registers the door service → absence pins red</summary>

```
× over a driver that carries ...  expected [ 'marketplace-install-local', …(2) ] to deeply equal [ …(2) ]
× the door-less kernel mounts no install-local route ...  expected true to be false
× both mounted (planner plugin first) / (install door first)
Tests  4 failed | 23 passed (27)
```
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- Changeset is `patch`, not the `minor` the dispatch asked for: `check-changeset-no-major` refuses a `minor` beside `Metadata-protocol: none` (the level follows the metadata protocol alone).
- Clause-② is `yes (widening)` per the claim amendment (6740126296), as #31801 recorded its new root exports; the changeset says the same. The level stays `patch`: `Metadata-protocol: none` takes `patch` (maintainer ruling A on #25105).
- The new plugin declares no `dependencies` on `ObjectQLPlugin`: init reads nothing, and the engine is resolved when `plan()` runs.
- On a kernel with no `objectql`, `plan()` resolves (never throws): each pending declared rename is a `transport` refusal ("the driver serving 'acme_lead' renames no column"), and a version with nothing pending answers `{ carries: [], refusals: [] }`. Measured at head `4a50dc0c` with the plugin's `init` over a context holding no engine.

## Verification

All readings on head `f9562c4a` (base `6a8f4151`; main has since moved 6 commits, none in `cloud-connection` or the planner's imports). `4a50dc0c` changes only the changeset's Clause-② line; `check-changeset-no-major`, `check-adr-0087-registration` and `check-empty-changeset` re-run there: exit 0.

- `pnpm exec vitest run src/marketplace-install-local-declared-rename.test.ts`: 27 passed (21 existing unchanged + 6 new).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cloud-connection test`: Test Files 80 passed (80), Tests 1144 passed (1144). Lock VERDICT command-exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cloud-connection typecheck` (both tsc programs, closure built with dts): VERDICT command-exit 0.
- eslint `--no-inline-config` on the four touched source files: exit 0. The package has no `lint` script.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands`: 69 families derived, all 69 exit 0. `--ran` reconciliation: 69 derived, 69 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN (a derived zero: every line carries its exit code).

<details><summary>Two gates needed a prerequisite before they measured</summary>

- `node scripts/check-plugin-teardown-shape.mjs --self-test` exited 3 on the shallow clone (its pinned fixture commit was unreachable). After fetching that one commit: exit 0, 48 cases pass.
- `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads` exited 3, PREREQUISITE NOT MET (packages had no `dist/`). After a full packages build: exit 0, 122 require entry points across 72 packages load.
</details>

Dogfood: not run. The title has no `!` and Clause-② has no `(narrowing)` arm.
